A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SEAR study and are readable throughout. Pages 2–19 have identical text and rendered appearance. However, both end with references and omit the cited Appendices A, B, and D; neither contains embedded attachments. The supplied content can be compared reliably, but those appendices cannot be assessed.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic and real-world image-restoration experiments, efficiency measurements, ablations, memory-routing results, and hyperparameter sensitivity analyses in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experiments and results in Section 4, including Tables 1–6 and the qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: Section 3 is identical: the Intuitive Executor, degradation fingerprints, memory retrieval and reliability gate, P-MCTS planner, hybrid reward, tournament selection, and memory evolution procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain MiO100-derived synthetic Groups A–C and the same real-world evaluation assembled from seven named datasets. No dataset, restoration task, or test scenario changes in the supplied content.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain AirNet, PromptIR, MiOIR, DA-CLIP, InstructIR, AutoDIR, AgenticIR, and 4KAgent. Table 2 retains the same AgenticIR and 4KAgent efficiency comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same sample counts, unified agentic toolsets, DepictQA evaluator, GPT-4o planner, hyperparameters, Y-channel PSNR/SSIM protocol, and perceptual metrics. The reported ablation and sensitivity settings also match.

E4.justification: Section 4.4, Tables 4–6, and Figures 6–8 are unchanged. They retain the same component ablations, memory evolution and routing analyses, reward-design comparisons, and hyperparameter sensitivity results.

E5.justification: Neither supplied version adds or revises repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All supplied numerical tables and qualitative result figures are identical. For example, Table 1 retains SEAR's Group B PSNR of 22.1332, and Table 2 retains its 1.98-minute runtime and 8.15 tool calls. Results referenced in the absent appendices cannot be checked.

T1.justification: The state/action formulation, trajectory objective, retrieval score, UCT expression, and backpropagation updates in Section 3 and Equations 1–4 are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs change in the supplied material.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about dual-process restoration, long-horizon planning, reusable episodic memory, and restoration quality and efficiency.

C2.justification: The interpretations of restoration quality, memory reuse, hierarchical planning, and perceptual alignment are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning degradation diagnosis, tool-library coverage, and cold-start search overhead.

D1.justification: The supplied implementation disclosures retain the same restoration tools, models, parameter values, NVIDIA V100 hardware, and planned public release of the real-world dataset. No technical or resource-access information changes; the referenced implementation appendices are absent from both files.

R1.justification: Section 2, the research-positioning passages, and all 66 reference entries are identical. No cited work or relationship to prior methods changes.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes the email domains for cuishuang21 and jifan22 from iscas.ac.cn to mails.ucas.ac.cn and regroups the contact list. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Visual changes are confined to the first-page email block and marginal arXiv stamp. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–6, and the layout of pages 2–19 are identical.

improvement.justification: Within the supplied PDFs, v2 only updates author contact information and the version/date stamp. The method, evidence, explanations, and limitations remain identical, establishing no meaningful change in overall paper quality. Both omit the cited appendices, so no improvement in that unavailable material can be established.
